mapper.sql: id, diary_id, original_url, thumb_url, sort_order, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `diary_image` (diary_id, original_url, thumb_url, sort_order) VALUES (#{diaryId}, #{originalUrl}, #{thumbUrl}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `diary_image` WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT di.id AS image_id, d.id AS diary_id, d.title AS diary_title, di.original_url, di.thumb_url, d.user_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, d.created_at FROM `diary_image` di JOIN `diary` d ON di.diary_id = d.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON d.user_id = u.id WHERE d.is_public = 1 ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC, di.sort_order ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `diary_image` di JOIN `diary` d ON di.diary_id = d.id WHERE d.is_public = 1
